tasks.short: Attend workshops to stay current in school psychology

steps.what: Attend workshops, seminars and professional meetings to remain informed of school psychology developments

tasks.design: She attends the workshop, seminar or professional meeting herself and listens for developments in school psychology. Nothing lists events, drafts notes from the session, or sends a registration.
tasks.previous_blocker: What matters is what she hears in that room, not a title list.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool can sit through the meeting in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A missed development can leave her using an outdated approach with a child.
tasks.human_edge: She notices which point actually changes the cases on her desk.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still attends the workshops and meetings herself.

reach.task: Apply one development she brought back to a shared case
reach.learn: Which finding from the meeting changes school practice

evidence.claim: Staying current by attending workshops and professional meetings is done by the psychologist in the room. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She attends in person and listens. She does not write or send anything in this task, so the step stays read and ungated.
Nothing lists workshops or drafts a summary. She still chooses the meeting and sits through it.
unknowns: Whether a workshop in a year requires a booked place the employer pays for.
research_questions: How many of these meetings in a year must she attend in person rather than read about afterwards?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still attends every workshop, seminar and professional meeting herself, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel children and families on learning and adjustment

steps.what: Counsel children and families to help solve conflicts and problems in learning and adjustment

tasks.design: She counsels the child or the family in the room on conflicts and problems in learning and adjustment. The counsel is spoken and no version is filed. Nothing drafts a session note, lists strategies, or sends a message.
tasks.previous_blocker: The counsel has to fit this child, this family and this classroom.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool holds that conversation in her place.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong counsel on a learning or family conflict can harm the child.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the child will actually say in the room.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still counsels the child and the family herself.

reach.task: Assess when the learning problem needs that examination
reach.learn: Which adjustment problem she already worked with the child

evidence.claim: Counsel on learning and adjustment is given by the psychologist in the room with the child or the family. This is model knowledge.
Health data is a special category of personal data.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Children and families are outside the organisation. The counsel is spoken and no version is filed, so the step stays ungated.
The conversation is not recorded. Nothing drafts a session note, lists strategies, or sends a message.
unknowns: Whether this school requires a session note after every counseling conversation.
research_questions: How often does a counseling conversation in a week turn on a learning plan rather than a family conflict?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still counsels every child and family herself, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Help families and schools with separation and loss

steps.what: Serve families as a resource during crises such as separation and loss
Help schools through those same crises of separation and loss

tasks.design: She serves the family in the room during a crisis such as separation or loss, then helps the school staff with that same crisis. Both talks are spoken and no version is filed. Nothing lists crisis steps, drafts a letter, or sends one.
tasks.previous_blocker: The family and the school need her judgement of this loss, not a generic script.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool sits with the family or the school in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A clumsy response to separation or loss can harm the child.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what this family can bear to hear today.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still helps the family and the school herself.

reach.task: Hold the crisis conversation the school cannot finish
reach.learn: What the family has already been told

evidence.claim: Help in a family or school crisis is given by the psychologist in the room. This is model knowledge.
Health data is a special category of personal data.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Families are outside the organisation. The help in s1 is spoken and no version is filed, so it stays ungated.
Teachers and school leaders are colleagues in the same organisation. The help in s2 is spoken and no version is filed, so it stays write_internal and ungated.
Nothing lists crisis steps, drafts a letter, or sends one. The conversations are not recorded.
unknowns: Whether she is employed by the school or by an outside service, which would make the school a client.
research_questions: How often is the school conversation with a colleague in the same organisation rather than with an outside school?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still serves every family and still helps every school through the crisis herself, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Refer students and families to community agencies

steps.what: Read which medical, vocational or social services the case needs
Refer students and their families to appropriate community agencies

tasks.design: She reads the case in the {DOCS} and judges the medical, vocational or social need, then refers the student and the family herself to the community agency. The referral is spoken and no version is filed. Nothing lists agencies, drafts a referral letter, or sends one.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agency has to fit this student, not the nearest name on a directory.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool knows which agency this family will actually reach.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong referral can delay medical, vocational or social help.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which agency this family can travel to and will trust.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the case and still makes the referral herself.

reach.task: Accept the student she referred for care beyond the school
reach.learn: Which service the family agreed to try

evidence.claim: A referral to a community agency is made by the psychologist with the student and the family. This is model knowledge.
Health data is a special category of personal data.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Students, families and community agencies are outside the organisation. The referral in s2 is spoken and no version is filed, so it stays ungated.
She still opens and reads the case notes in s1. Nothing lists agencies, drafts a referral letter, or sends one.
unknowns: Whether some referrals in this school leave as a written letter rather than a spoken introduction.
research_questions: How many referrals in a week are spoken introductions, and how many are letters that leave a filed copy?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still reads every case and still refers every student and family herself, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is unchanged. She still attends the meetings, still counsels in the room, still helps in a crisis, and still makes the referral herself.
reach: The clinical psychologist uses a development she brought back from a meeting.
The neuropsychologist continues when a learning problem needs that assessment.
The clinical psychologist takes a crisis or a referral she cannot finish in school.
skills_to_grow: Pick the one development from a meeting that changes a case.
Counsel a child without taking the problem away from the family.
Name one agency that fits this student.
role.ambitious_version: She still attends, counsels, sits with the crisis, and refers the family herself.
